title: The Maze II
goal: Find the shortest distance a rolling ball travels to stop exactly at the destination.
strategy: Run Dijkstra over the cells where the ball can stop. Repeatedly finish the closest unfinished stop, roll from it in each direction, and record shorter distances to the stops reached.

phasePurposes.start: Start at the ball position with distance 0.
phasePurposes.pick: Finish the closest unfinished stop; its distance is final.
phasePurposes.roll: Roll in one direction until a wall or edge stops the ball.
phasePurposes.relax: Record a shorter distance to the stop reached.
phasePurposes.done: The destination is finished with its shortest distance.
phasePurposes.lose: No unfinished stop is reachable, so the answer is -1.

edgeCases: A ball boxed in by walls returns -1
A start that is the destination returns 0
The ball must stop at the destination, not merely pass it
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.

verification.reason: Unit tests cover the algorithm; the page has not been checked in a browser.
